rationale: The only report site (LinkerAnalysisStep.SubstitutionGenerator, when the declaring syntax of the overridden member is the record declaration itself) matches the text: the member is synthesized by the compiler, so meta.Proceed() has no body to call. The message names the member and gives the fix, without contractions.
codeChange: The diagnostic is thrown as an exception without a location, so it appears without a source location. Passing the location of the record declaration (or of the aspect attribute) would help users find the offending type.
